description: Source code for a REST API class managing annotations in the Superset project, including CRUD operations and bulk delete, with schema validation and command execution.

classes.name: AnnotationRestApi
classes.description: REST API class for managing annotation entities, providing endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, and bulk deleting annotations with schema validation and permission controls.

methods.name: _apply_layered_relation_to_rison
methods.description: Adds a filter relation to the rison parameters based on layer ID.

methods.name: get_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of annotations for a given layer ID, applying layered relation filters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific annotation by ID within a layer, applying layered relation filters.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Creates a new annotation within a specified layer, validating input schema and handling errors.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Updates an existing annotation by ID, validating input schema and handling errors.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific annotation by ID.

methods.name: bulk_delete
methods.description: Performs bulk deletion of annotations based on provided IDs.
